tour.title: Project Overview & Clinical Architecture Standards
tour.description: Start with README.md and AGENTS.md to understand Thoen Hospital's medical mission, PDPA/PHI privacy compliance, and strict Zero-Database socket architecture.

tour.title: Zero-Database Centralized API Gateway
tour.description: Inspect the core ApiGatewayClient that routes all hospital database traffic to the centralized gateway VM, enforcing fail-closed security without direct database socket connections.

tour.title: Multi-Database Adapters & Prisma Modeling
tour.description: Explore data access adapters: queryClinicalDb for HOSxP read-only queries, queryMemberDb for transactional operations, salaryDb for pay slips, and Prisma schema definitions.

tour.title: Two-Tier Audit Logging & Security Compliance
tour.description: Understand compliance audit logging: Tier-1 logs patient PHI and salary access to immutable audit tables, while structured pino logging manages operational telemetry.

tour.title: Staff Authentication & ThaID OAuth Integration
tour.description: Learn how hospital staff login works through passwordless OTP, ThaID digital ID OAuth integration, and defensive server-side session verification.

tour.title: Hospital Domain Services & Workflow Engines
tour.description: Examine domain services managing inpatient ward bed occupancy, inbox ticket workflows, RBAC permission resolvers, and equipment borrowing.

tour.title: Thin API Route Adapters & Gateways
tour.description: Review how Next.js API route handlers validate requests, enforce session/RBAC boundaries, and delegate business logic directly to domain services.

tour.title: Hospital Portals & User Interface
tour.description: Explore public-facing news and status pages, staff dashboard, and workflow inbox management views.

tour.title: Operational Infrastructure & Automation Scripts
tour.description: Review operational maintenance tools, automated database backups, Thai citizen ID smartcard bridge, and scheduled background bots.
